mapper.select: select * from wxuser where userPhone=#{userPhone} and userPassword=#{userPassword}

select * from wxuser where ((userId in(select distinct(messageSender) from message where messageReciver=#{messageSender} and messageDate>#{messageDate})) or (userid in (select distinct(messageReciver) from message where (messageSender=#{messageSender} or messageReader=#{messageSender}) and messageDate>#{messageDate})) or (userid in (select distinct(messageSender) from message where (messageReader=#{messageSender}) and messageDate>#{messageDate}))) order by gxsj desc
select * from messagehis order by messageDate desc
select * from wxuser where (userId in(select distinct(messageSender) from message where messageReciver=#{loginId} and isnull(messageReader,'0')='0' and messageSender<>0))order by gxsj desc
